coverage: Both full English editions, all twenty-four books: named people, gods, personified powers, named horses and named peoples. Places, rivers as geography, mountains, islands, ships and adjectival forms of place names are excluded; a river that speaks or fights is included.

entities.name: Achilles
entities.body: Son of Peleus and Thetis, the best fighter among the Greeks; the poem opens with his quarrel with Agamemnon.

entities.name: Hector
entities.body: Priam’s eldest son and the commander of Troy’s defence.

entities.name: Agamemnon
entities.body: King of Mycenae and commander-in-chief of the Greek army, Menelaus’s brother.

entities.name: Patroclus
entities.body: Son of Menoetius and Achilles’ closest companion, raised in Peleus’s house.

entities.name: Priam
entities.body: The old king of Troy, father of Hector and of fifty sons.

entities.name: Menelaus
entities.body: King of Sparta and Agamemnon’s brother; the war is fought over his wife.

entities.name: Helen
entities.body: Menelaus’s wife, now living in Troy with Paris; the woman the war is fought over.

entities.name: Paris
entities.body: Priam’s son, who carried Helen away from Sparta. The poem calls him Alexandrus as often as Paris.

entities.name: Odysseus
entities.body: King of Ithaca, the shrewdest of the Greek captains. Butler’s original calls him Ulysses.

entities.name: Diomed
entities.body: Son of Tydeus and, after Achilles, the most dangerous fighter on the Greek side. The modern edition also spells him Diomedes.

entities.name: Nestor
entities.body: The old king of Pylos, knight of Gerene, who has outlived two generations and advises everyone.

entities.name: Ajax
entities.body: Son of Telamon, the biggest man in the Greek army and its most reliable defender.

entities.name: Ajax son of Oileus
entities.body: The Locrian captain, a small man and the fastest runner in the army; called Ajax the less to distinguish him from Telamon’s son.

entities.name: The two Ajaxes
entities.body: Ajax son of Telamon and Ajax son of Oileus, who fight side by side and are often named as a pair.

entities.name: Aeneas
entities.body: Son of Anchises and Aphrodite, leader of the Dardanians and the best Trojan fighter after Hector.

entities.name: Sarpedon
entities.body: Son of Zeus and captain of the Lycians, the strongest of Troy’s allies.

entities.name: Glaucus
entities.body: Son of Hippolochus and Sarpedon’s second in command among the Lycians.

entities.name: Idomeneus
entities.body: King of Crete, son of Deucalion, and one of the older Greek captains.

entities.name: Meriones
entities.body: Idomeneus’s second in command among the Cretans, son of Molus.

entities.name: Antilochus
entities.body: Nestor’s son, the fastest runner among the younger Greek captains.

entities.name: Teucer
entities.body: Ajax’s half-brother by the same father, and the best archer in the Greek army.

entities.name: Polydamas
entities.body: Son of Panthous, born the same night as Hector; the one Trojan whose counsel Hector ought to take.

entities.name: Briseis
entities.body: The woman awarded to Achilles from the sack of Lyrnessus, whom Agamemnon takes from him.

entities.name: Chryseis
entities.body: Chryses’s daughter, taken as Agamemnon’s prize; her father’s prayer brings the plague.

entities.name: Chryses
entities.body: Priest of Apollo, father of Chryseis, whose rejected ransom opens the poem.

entities.name: Calchas
entities.body: Son of Thestor and the army’s chief augur, who guided the fleet to Troy.

entities.name: Andromache
entities.body: Hector’s wife, daughter of Eetion of Thebe.

entities.name: Astyanax
entities.body: Hector and Andromache’s baby son. His father named him Scamandrius; the people call him Astyanax.

entities.name: Hecuba
entities.body: Priam’s wife and queen of Troy, mother of Hector and Paris.

entities.name: Automedon
entities.body: Son of Diores and Achilles’ charioteer, who drives for Patroclus in his place.

entities.name: Phoenix
entities.body: The old man who brought Achilles up in Peleus’s house and is sent as one of the three envoys to him.

entities.name: Thersites
entities.body: The ugliest and most abusive man in the Greek army, beaten by Odysseus for railing at Agamemnon.

entities.name: Dolon
entities.body: Son of the herald Eumedes, a rich Trojan who volunteers to spy on the Greek camp by night.

entities.name: Rhesus
entities.body: The newly arrived Thracian king whose white horses Odysseus and Diomed carry off.

entities.name: Machaon
entities.body: A son of Aesculapius and one of the army’s two surgeons.

entities.name: Podalirius
entities.body: A son of Aesculapius and, with his brother Machaon, a surgeon to the army.

entities.name: Thetis
entities.body: A sea goddess, Achilles’ mother, married to the mortal Peleus.

entities.name: Peleus
entities.body: Achilles’ father, an old king among the Myrmidons.

entities.name: Menoetius
entities.body: Patroclus’s father, son of Actor, who put his son in Peleus’s care.

entities.name: Atreus
entities.body: Father of Agamemnon and Menelaus.

entities.name: Tydeus
entities.body: Diomed’s father, one of the Seven against Thebes, and a byword for reckless courage.

entities.name: Telamon
entities.body: Father of Ajax and Teucer.

entities.name: Oileus
entities.body: Father of Ajax the less and of the bastard Medon.

entities.name: Laertes
entities.body: Odysseus’s father.

entities.name: Anchises
entities.body: Aeneas’s father, whom Aphrodite loved on the slopes of Ida.

entities.name: Hippolochus
entities.body: Glaucus’s father, son of Bellerophon.

entities.name: Antenor
entities.body: An elder of Troy and its wisest counsellor, who argues for giving Helen back.

entities.name: Theano
entities.body: Daughter of Cisseus, wife of Antenor and priestess of Athena in Troy.

entities.name: Deiphobus
entities.body: A son of Priam and one of Troy’s leading fighters.

entities.name: Helenus
entities.body: A son of Priam and the best augur in Troy.

entities.name: Cebriones
entities.body: A bastard son of Priam who drives Hector’s chariot.

entities.name: Polydorus
entities.body: Priam’s youngest and dearest son, whom his father forbade to fight.

entities.name: Lycaon
entities.body: A son of Priam by Laothoe, sold into slavery by Achilles and taken again at the river.

entities.name: Pandarus
entities.body: Son of Lycaon of Zelea, the archer who breaks the truce by shooting Menelaus.

entities.name: Lycaon
entities.body: Pandarus’s father, of Zelea under Ida.

entities.name: Asius
entities.body: Son of Hyrtacus, a Trojan ally who refuses to leave his chariot at the wall.

entities.name: Idaeus
entities.body: Priam’s herald, who drives for him and carries his messages.

entities.name: Talthybius
entities.body: One of Agamemnon’s two heralds.

entities.name: Eurybates
entities.body: A herald of the Greek army; the man of Ithaca who attends Odysseus.

entities.name: Agenor
entities.body: A son of Antenor and one of the steadiest Trojan fighters.

entities.name: Asteropaeus
entities.body: Son of Pelegon and grandson of the river Axius, captain of the Paeonians and ambidextrous with the spear.

entities.name: Euphorbus
entities.body: Son of Panthous, the Trojan who wounds Patroclus first.

entities.name: Eurypylus
entities.body: Son of Euaemon, a Greek captain who is wounded in the thigh and nursed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Menestheus
entities.body: Son of Peteos and captain of the Athenians.

entities.name: Meges
entities.body: Son of Phyleus and captain of the men of Dulichium.

entities.name: Thrasymedes
entities.body: A son of Nestor and a captain of the night watch.

entities.name: Sthenelus
entities.body: Son of Capaneus and Diomed’s charioteer and constant companion.

entities.name: Protesilaus
entities.body: The first Greek killed at Troy, leaping ashore ahead of the rest; his men now follow Podarces.

entities.name: Podarces
entities.body: Son of Iphiclus, who leads Protesilaus’s men after his brother’s death.

entities.name: Philoctetes
entities.body: The skilful archer left behind sick on Lemnos, whose men came without him.

entities.name: Zeus
entities.body: King of the gods, who holds the balance of the war. Butler’s original calls him Jove throughout, with a single slip into Zeus at 16:51.

entities.name: Hera
entities.body: Zeus’s wife and sister, implacably against Troy. Butler’s original calls her Juno.

entities.name: Athena
entities.body: Zeus’s daughter, goddess of war and craft, and the Greeks’ fiercest partisan. Butler’s original calls her Minerva.

entities.name: Apollo
entities.body: God of archery and plague, and Troy’s chief defender among the gods; also called Phoebus.

entities.name: Poseidon
entities.body: God of the sea and the earthquake, who works for the Greeks against his brother’s orders. Butler’s original calls him Neptune.

entities.name: Ares
entities.body: God of war, who fights on the Trojan side until Diomed wounds him. Butler’s original calls him Mars.

entities.name: Aphrodite
entities.body: Goddess of love, Aeneas’s mother, and Paris’s protector. Butler’s original calls her Venus.

entities.name: Hephaestus
entities.body: The lame smith of the gods, who makes Achilles’ new armour. Butler’s original calls him Vulcan.

entities.name: Hermes
entities.body: The messenger god, who guides Priam through the Greek camp. Butler’s original calls him Mercury.

entities.name: Artemis
entities.body: Goddess of the hunt and Apollo’s sister. Butler’s original calls her Diana.

entities.name: Iris
entities.body: The gods’ messenger, who carries their orders down to the plain.

entities.name: Leto
entities.body: Mother of Apollo and Artemis; the original also names her Latona.

entities.name: Hades
entities.body: God of the world below; the name also stands for his house.

entities.name: Persephone
entities.body: Queen of the dead. Butler’s original calls her Proserpine.

entities.name: Demeter
entities.body: Goddess of the harvest. Butler’s original calls her Ceres.

entities.name: Cronus
entities.body: Zeus’s father, imprisoned below with the Titans. Butler’s original calls him Saturn.

entities.name: Rhea
entities.body: Mother of Zeus, Poseidon and Hades. The original spells her Rhaea.

entities.name: Dione
entities.body: Aphrodite’s mother, who comforts her on Olympus after Diomed wounds her.

entities.name: Hebe
entities.body: Daughter of Zeus and Hera, who pours the nectar and harnesses Hera’s chariot.

entities.name: Themis
entities.body: A goddess of Olympus who greets Hera on her return and summons the gods to council.

entities.name: Charis
entities.body: Hephaestus’s wife, who receives Thetis in the smith’s house.

entities.name: Dawn
entities.body: The goddess of daybreak, who rises from beside Tithonus.

entities.name: Oceanus
entities.body: The stream encircling the earth, spoken of as the father of the gods.

entities.name: Tethys
entities.body: Oceanus’s wife, named with him as the source of the gods.

entities.name: Sleep
entities.body: Death’s own brother, whom Hera bribes to close Zeus’s eyes.

entities.name: Scamander
entities.body: The river of the Trojan plain, who rises against Achilles; men call him Scamander and the gods Xanthus.

entities.name: Ilithuia
entities.body: Goddess of the pains of childbirth. The original also uses the plural Ilithuiae.

entities.name: Paeeon
entities.body: The healer of the gods, who cures Ares and Hades of their wounds.

entities.name: Bacchus
entities.body: God of wine, driven into the sea by Lycurgus when he was young.

entities.name: The Erinyes
entities.body: The avenging spirits a wronged parent calls down; the original also uses the singular Erinys.

entities.name: The Muses
entities.body: The nine goddesses of song, invoked for the catalogue of ships; the poem also addresses one Muse.

entities.name: Nereus
entities.body: The old sea god, Thetis’s father.

entities.name: Boreas
entities.body: The north wind, spoken of as a god.

entities.name: Zephyrus
entities.body: The west wind, spoken of as a god and as the sire of Achilles’ horses.

entities.name: Podarge
entities.body: The harpy who bore Achilles’ immortal horses to the west wind.

entities.name: Enyo
entities.body: A goddess of battle, named beside Athena as a waster of cities.

entities.name: Stentor
entities.body: The brazen-voiced herald whose shout Hera borrows.

entities.name: Aegaeon
entities.body: The hundred-handed monster whom the gods call Briareus and men Aegaeon.

entities.name: The Titans
entities.body: The elder gods imprisoned with Cronus below the earth.

entities.name: Iapetus
entities.body: A Titan imprisoned with Cronus in the depths below.

entities.name: The Gorgon
entities.body: The monstrous head set on Athena’s aegis and on Agamemnon’s shield; also called Gorgo.

entities.name: Styx
entities.body: The river of the world below, by which the gods swear.

entities.name: Orcus
entities.body: The dread power of the world below, of whom the Titaresius is called a branch.

entities.name: Achelous
entities.body: A great river named as second only to Zeus among waters.

entities.name: The Graces
entities.body: The goddesses of grace; Hera promises one of them, Pasithea, to Sleep.

entities.name: Pasithea
entities.body: The youngest of the Graces, whom Hera promises to Sleep in marriage.

entities.name: The Olympians
entities.body: The gods of Olympus, taken together.

entities.name: The sea-nymphs
entities.body: Thetis’s sisters, the daughters of Nereus, who gather round her in the sea.

entities.name: Strife
entities.body: The goddess of discord, who is sent to the ships and grows until her head touches heaven; the original also names Riot and Rumour beside her.

entities.name: Glauce
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Cymodoce
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Nesaia
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Speo
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Thoe
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Halie
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Cymothoe
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Actaea
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Limnorea
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Melite
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Iaera
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Amphithoe
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Agave
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Doto
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Proto
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Pherusa
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Dynamene
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Dexamene
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Amphinome
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Callianeira
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Doris
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Panope
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Galatea
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Nemertes
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Apseudes
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Callianassa
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Clymene
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Ianeira
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Ianassa
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Maera
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Oreithuia
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Amatheia
entities.body: One of the sea-nymphs, daughters of Nereus, who gather round Thetis when she mourns.

entities.name: Peneleos
entities.body: A captain of the Boeotians.

entities.name: Leitus
entities.body: A captain of the Boeotians.

entities.name: Arcesilaus
entities.body: A captain of the Boeotians.

entities.name: Prothoenor
entities.body: A captain of the Boeotians, son of Areilycus.

entities.name: Clonius
entities.body: A captain of the Boeotians.

entities.name: Areilycus
entities.body: Father of the Boeotian captain Prothoenor.

entities.name: Ascalaphus
entities.body: A son of Ares who leads the men of Aspledon and Orchomenus.

entities.name: Ialmenus
entities.body: A son of Ares who leads the men of Aspledon and Orchomenus with his brother.

entities.name: Astyoche
entities.body: The maiden who bore Ascalaphus and Ialmenus to Ares in Actor’s house.

entities.name: Actor
entities.body: Son of Azeus, in whose house Astyoche bore the sons of Ares.

entities.name: Azeus
entities.body: Father of the Actor in whose house Ascalaphus and Ialmenus were born.

entities.name: Schedius
entities.body: A captain of the Phoceans, son of Iphitus.

entities.name: Schedius
entities.body: A leader of the Phoceans, son of Perimedes, killed by Hector.

entities.name: Epistrophus
entities.body: A captain of the Phoceans, son of Iphitus.

entities.name: Iphitus
entities.body: Father of the Phocean captains Schedius and Epistrophus.

entities.name: Iphitus
entities.body: Father of Archeptolemus, Hector’s second charioteer.

entities.name: Naubolus
entities.body: Grandfather of the Phocean captains.

entities.name: Perimedes
entities.body: Father of the Phocean leader Schedius killed by Hector.

entities.name: Elephenor
entities.body: Son of Chalcodon and chief of the Abantes of Euboea.

entities.name: Chalcodon
entities.body: Father of Elephenor.

entities.name: Peteos
entities.body: Father of Menestheus of Athens.

entities.name: Agapenor
entities.body: Son of Ancaeus and commander of the Arcadians.

entities.name: Ancaeus
entities.body: Father of the Arcadian commander Agapenor.

entities.name: Amphimachus
entities.body: Son of Cteatus and one of the four Epean captains; Poseidon’s grandson.

entities.name: Amphimachus
entities.body: A son of Nomion who leads the Carians and comes to war wearing gold.

entities.name: Thalpius
entities.body: Son of Eurytus and one of the four Epean captains.

entities.name: Cteatus
entities.body: One of the Moliones, father of the Epean captain Amphimachus.

entities.name: Eurytus
entities.body: One of the Moliones, father of the Epean captain Thalpius.

entities.name: The two Moliones
entities.body: The twin sons of Actor whom Nestor could not beat in his youth, saved by Poseidon.

entities.name: Actor
entities.body: Father of the Moliones; the Epean captains are called men of his race.

entities.name: Diores
entities.body: Son of Amarynceus and one of the four Epean captains.

entities.name: Amarynceus
entities.body: Father of the Epean captain Diores.

entities.name: Polyxenus
entities.body: Son of Agasthenes and one of the four Epean captains.

entities.name: Agasthenes
entities.body: Father of the Epean captain Polyxenus, son of Augeas.

entities.name: Augeas
entities.body: King of Elis in the old days, grandfather of Polyxenus.

entities.name: Phyleus
entities.body: Meges’s father, who quarrelled with his own father and settled in Dulichium.

entities.name: Tlepolemus
entities.body: Son of Heracles, who brought nine ships from Rhodes and is killed by Sarpedon.

entities.name: Tlepolemus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus in his charge on the city.

entities.name: Astyochea
entities.body: The woman Heracles carried off from Ephyra, mother of Tlepolemus.

entities.name: Licymnius
entities.body: Heracles’ uncle, killed by the young Tlepolemus.

entities.name: Nireus
entities.body: The handsomest man who came to Troy after Achilles, though he brought few men.

entities.name: Pheidippus
entities.body: A son of Thessalus who leads the men of Cos and Nisyrus.

entities.name: Antiphus
entities.body: A son of Thessalus who leads the men of Cos and Nisyrus with his brother.

entities.name: Eumelus
entities.body: Son of Admetus and Alcestis, who drives the finest horses in the Greek army.

entities.name: Admetus
entities.body: Eumelus’s father.

entities.name: Alcestis
entities.body: Eumelus’s mother, loveliest of the daughters of Pelias.

entities.name: Pelias
entities.body: Alcestis’s father.

entities.name: Medon
entities.body: The bastard son of Oileus by Rhene, Ajax the less’s half-brother, living in exile at Phylace.

entities.name: Medon
entities.body: A Trojan ally whom Hector cheers on in the fight for Patroclus’s body.

entities.name: Rhene
entities.body: Oileus’s concubine, mother of Medon.

entities.name: Eriopis
entities.body: Oileus’s wife, whose kinsman Medon killed.

entities.name: Iphiclus
entities.body: Podarces’s father, rich in sheep.

entities.name: Phylacus
entities.body: Grandfather of Podarces and Protesilaus.

entities.name: Phylacus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Leitus as he fled.

entities.name: Prothous
entities.body: Son of Tenthredon and commander of the Magnetes.

entities.name: Tenthredon
entities.body: Father of the Magnete commander Prothous.

entities.name: Guneus
entities.body: The captain who brought two and twenty ships from Cyphus.

entities.name: Polypoetes
entities.body: Son of Pirithous and one of the two Lapith captains who hold the gate.

entities.name: Leonteus
entities.body: Son of Coronus and the other Lapith captain at the gate.

entities.name: Coronus
entities.body: Leonteus’s father, son of Caeneus.

entities.name: Pirithous
entities.body: Polypoetes’s father, a son of Zeus by Ixion’s wife and one of the great men of the last age.

entities.name: Lycomedes
entities.body: Son of Creion, a Greek captain of the night watch.

entities.name: Creion
entities.body: Father of Lycomedes; the poem also spells the name Creontes.

entities.name: Aphareus
entities.body: A Greek captain of the night watch, son of Caletor.

entities.name: Caletor
entities.body: Father of the Greek captain Aphareus.

entities.name: Deipyrus
entities.body: A Greek captain of the night watch, killed by Helenus.

entities.name: Stichius
entities.body: A captain of the Athenians.

entities.name: Pheidas
entities.body: A captain of the Athenians.

entities.name: Bias
entities.body: A captain of the Athenians.

entities.name: Bias
entities.body: A Pylian chief marshalling Nestor’s men.

entities.name: Bias
entities.body: Father of the Trojans Laogonus and Dardanus.

entities.name: Amphion
entities.body: A commander of the Epeans at the ships.

entities.name: Dracius
entities.body: A commander of the Epeans at the ships.

entities.name: Pelagon
entities.body: A Pylian chief marshalling Nestor’s men.

entities.name: Haemon
entities.body: A Pylian chief marshalling Nestor’s men.

entities.name: Haemon
entities.body: Father of the Theban captain Maeon.

entities.name: Haemon
entities.body: Father of Laerces and grandfather of Alcimedon.

entities.name: Alcimedon
entities.body: A Myrmidon captain, son of Laerces, who takes the reins from Automedon. His father’s name is spelled Laerceus at 16:10 and Laerces at 17:29.

entities.name: Laerces
entities.body: Alcimedon’s father; the poem spells the name Laerceus once and Laerces once.

entities.name: Alcimus
entities.body: A Myrmidon who harnesses Achilles’ chariot with Automedon.

entities.name: Menesthius
entities.body: Captain of the first Myrmidon company, son of the river Spercheius and Polydora.

entities.name: Menesthius
entities.body: A Trojan of Arne, son of Areithous the Mace-man, killed by Paris.

entities.name: Polydora
entities.body: Peleus’s daughter, mother of the Myrmidon Menesthius by the river Spercheius.

entities.name: Spercheius
entities.body: A river that streams from heaven, father of the Myrmidon Menesthius.

entities.name: Borus
entities.body: Son of Perieres, who married Polydora and was called Menesthius’s father.

entities.name: Borus
entities.body: A Meonian, father of Phaesus.

entities.name: Perieres
entities.body: Father of Borus.

entities.name: Eudorus
entities.body: Captain of the second Myrmidon company, son of Hermes and Polymele.

entities.name: Polymele
entities.body: Phylas’s daughter, mother of Eudorus by Hermes.

entities.name: Phylas
entities.body: Polymele’s father, a graceful dancer.

entities.name: Echecles
entities.body: Son of Actor, who married Polymele after Eudorus was born.

entities.name: Actor
entities.body: Father of Echecles, who married Polymele.

entities.name: Pisander
entities.body: Captain of the third Myrmidon company, son of Maemalus and the best spearman among them after Patroclus.

entities.name: Maemalus
entities.body: Father of the Myrmidon captain Pisander.

entities.name: Epeigeus
entities.body: A Myrmidon, son of Agacles, once king in Budeum, killed by Hector.

entities.name: Agacles
entities.body: Father of the Myrmidon Epeigeus.

entities.name: Hecamede
entities.body: Daughter of Arsinous, awarded to Nestor from Tenedos, who mixes the drink in his tent.

entities.name: Arsinous
entities.body: Hecamede’s father, of Tenedos.

entities.name: Diomede
entities.body: Phorbas’s daughter, carried off from Lesbos and given to Achilles.

entities.name: Phorbas
entities.body: Father of Diomede of Lesbos.

entities.name: Phorbas
entities.body: A rich Trojan flock-master favoured by Hermes, father of Ilioneus.

entities.name: Iphis
entities.body: The woman Achilles gave to Patroclus when he took Scyros.

entities.name: Enyeus
entities.body: King of Scyros when Achilles took it.

entities.name: Panthous
entities.body: A Trojan elder, father of Polydamas, Euphorbus and Hyperenor.

entities.name: Lampus
entities.body: A Trojan elder, son of Laomedon and father of Dolops.

entities.name: Clytius
entities.body: A Trojan elder, son of Laomedon and father of Caletor.

entities.name: Hiketaon
entities.body: A Trojan elder of the race of Ares, father of Melanippus. The modern edition spells him Hicetaon.

entities.name: Thymoetes
entities.body: A Trojan elder seated with Priam at the Scaean gates.

entities.name: Ucalegon
entities.body: A Trojan elder and one of the two sages seated by the Scaean gates.

entities.name: Laomedon
entities.body: Priam’s father, who cheated Poseidon and Apollo of their wages.

entities.name: Dardanus
entities.body: Zeus’s son and the founder of the Trojan line.

entities.name: Dardanus
entities.body: A Trojan, son of Bias, killed by Achilles.

entities.name: Erichthonius
entities.body: Dardanus’s son, the wealthiest man of his time, whose mares the north wind covered.

entities.name: Tros
entities.body: Erichthonius’s son and king of the Trojans, who gave his name to the people.

entities.name: Tros
entities.body: A young Trojan, son of Alastor, who clasps Achilles’ knees in vain.

entities.name: Ilus
entities.body: Tros’s son, whose tomb stands in the middle of the plain.

entities.name: Assaracus
entities.body: Tros’s son, Capys’s father and Aeneas’s great-grandfather.

entities.name: Ganymede
entities.body: Tros’s son, the comeliest of mortals, carried up to be Zeus’s cup-bearer.

entities.name: Capys
entities.body: Assaracus’s son and Anchises’ father.

entities.name: Tithonus
entities.body: Laomedon’s son and Dawn’s consort.

entities.name: Laothoe
entities.body: Daughter of Altes, one of Priam’s wives and mother of Lycaon and Polydorus.

entities.name: Altes
entities.body: King of the Lelegae at Pedasus and Laothoe’s father.

entities.name: Castianeira
entities.body: One of Priam’s wives, mother of Gorgythion.

entities.name: Gorgythion
entities.body: A son of Priam killed by an arrow meant for Hector.

entities.name: Laodice
entities.body: Priam’s fairest daughter, married to Helicaon son of Antenor.

entities.name: Laodice
entities.body: One of Agamemnon’s three daughters, offered to Achilles.

entities.name: Chrysothemis
entities.body: One of Agamemnon’s three daughters, offered to Achilles.

entities.name: Iphianassa
entities.body: One of Agamemnon’s three daughters, offered to Achilles.

entities.name: Orestes
entities.body: Agamemnon’s son, being brought up at home in all abundance.

entities.name: Orestes
entities.body: A Greek charioteer killed by Ares and Hector.

entities.name: Orestes
entities.body: A Trojan captain in Asius’s company, killed by Leonteus.

entities.name: Cassandra
entities.body: Priam’s fairest daughter, promised to Othryoneus for driving the Greeks away.

entities.name: Helicaon
entities.body: A son of Antenor, married to Priam’s daughter Laodice.

entities.name: Cisseus
entities.body: Theano’s father.

entities.name: Archelochus
entities.body: A son of Antenor who leads a Trojan company with his brother Acamas.

entities.name: Acamas
entities.body: A son of Antenor who leads a Trojan company with Archelochus.

entities.name: Acamas
entities.body: Son of Eussorus and chief of the Thracians, the best man among them.

entities.name: Eussorus
entities.body: Father of the Thracian chief Acamas.

entities.name: Polybus
entities.body: A son of Antenor, in Hector’s company at the wall.

entities.name: Iphidamas
entities.body: A son of Antenor brought up in Thrace by his grandfather Cisses, killed by Agamemnon.

entities.name: Cisses
entities.body: Iphidamas’s grandfather, who brought him up in Thrace.

entities.name: Coon
entities.body: Antenor’s eldest son, who wounds Agamemnon avenging his brother.

entities.name: Pedaeus
entities.body: A bastard son of Antenor brought up by Theano as her own, killed by Meges.

entities.name: Laodocus
entities.body: A son of Antenor whose shape Athena takes to find Pandarus.

entities.name: Laodocus
entities.body: A comrade of Antilochus, who takes his armour when he runs from the fight.

entities.name: Polites
entities.body: A son of Priam, fleet of foot, who watches from Aesyetes’ tomb.

entities.name: Aesyetes
entities.body: A Trojan of old whose tomb serves as the Trojans’ watch-post.

entities.name: Antiphus
entities.body: A son of Priam born in wedlock, killed by Agamemnon beside his bastard brother.

entities.name: Isus
entities.body: A bastard son of Priam, killed by Agamemnon beside his brother Antiphus.

entities.name: Agathon
entities.body: A son of Priam, upbraided by his father as he prepares for the ransom.

entities.name: Pammon
entities.body: A son of Priam, upbraided by his father as he prepares for the ransom.

entities.name: Antiphonus
entities.body: A son of Priam, upbraided by his father as he prepares for the ransom.

entities.name: Hippothous
entities.body: A son of Priam, upbraided by his father as he prepares for the ransom.

entities.name: Dius
entities.body: A son of Priam, upbraided by his father as he prepares for the ransom.

entities.name: Troilus
entities.body: A son of Priam, a dauntless charioteer, already dead when the poem opens.

entities.name: Nestor
entities.body: A son of Priam, named among the bravest his father has lost.

entities.name: Doryclus
entities.body: A bastard son of Priam, killed by Ajax.

entities.name: Echemmon
entities.body: A son of Priam killed by Diomed in his brother’s chariot.

entities.name: Chromius
entities.body: A son of Priam killed by Diomed in his brother’s chariot.

entities.name: Hippothous
entities.body: Son of the Pelasgian Lethus, who leads the Pelasgian spearsmen.

entities.name: Pylaeus
entities.body: Son of the Pelasgian Lethus, who leads the Pelasgian spearsmen with his brother.

entities.name: Lethus
entities.body: The Pelasgian father of Hippothous and Pylaeus, son of Teutamus.

entities.name: Teutamus
entities.body: Grandfather of the Pelasgian captains.

entities.name: Peirous
entities.body: Son of Imbrasus and captain of the Thracians, who kills Diores and is killed by Thoas.

entities.name: Imbrasus
entities.body: Father of the Thracian captain Peirous.

entities.name: Euphemus
entities.body: Son of Troezenus and captain of the Ciconian spearsmen.

entities.name: Troezenus
entities.body: Father of the Ciconian captain Euphemus.

entities.name: Pyraechmes
entities.body: Leader of the Paeonian archers from Amydon.

entities.name: Pelegon
entities.body: Asteropaeus’s father, son of the river Axius and Periboea.

entities.name: Axius
entities.body: A broad river spoken of as Pelegon’s father.

entities.name: Periboea
entities.body: Acessamenus’s eldest daughter, mother of Pelegon by the river Axius.

entities.name: Odius
entities.body: A captain of the Halizoni from Alybe.

entities.name: Epistrophus
entities.body: A captain of the Halizoni from Alybe.

entities.name: Epistrophus
entities.body: A son of king Evenor of Lyrnessus, overthrown by Achilles.

entities.name: Mynes
entities.body: A son of king Evenor of Lyrnessus, overthrown by Achilles.

entities.name: Evenor
entities.body: King of Lyrnessus, father of Mynes and Epistrophus.

entities.name: Chromis
entities.body: A leader of the Mysians.

entities.name: Ennomus
entities.body: A Mysian augur whose skill did not save him from Achilles in the river.

entities.name: Phorcys
entities.body: A leader of the Phrygians from Ascania, son of Phaenops, killed by Ajax.

entities.name: Ascanius
entities.body: A leader of the Phrygians from Ascania.

entities.name: Mesthles
entities.body: A commander of the Meonians, son of Talaemenes.

entities.name: Antiphus
entities.body: A commander of the Meonians, son of Talaemenes.

entities.name: Talaemenes
entities.body: Father of the Meonian commanders.

entities.name: Nastes
entities.body: A leader of the Carians, son of Nomion.

entities.name: Nomion
entities.body: Father of the Carian leaders Nastes and Amphimachus.

entities.name: Pylaemenes
entities.body: Commander of the Paphlagonians; the original spells the name Pylaemanes at his first appearance.

entities.name: Harpalion
entities.body: Son of Pylaemenes, who came to Troy with his father and did not go home again.

entities.name: Adrestus
entities.body: A leader of the men of Adresteia and Apaesus, son of Merops.

entities.name: Amphius
entities.body: A leader of the men of Adresteia and Apaesus, son of Merops, whose breastplate was of linen.

entities.name: Merops
entities.body: A diviner of Percote who forbade his sons to go to the war.

entities.name: Adrestus
entities.body: A Trojan thrown from his chariot, who begs Menelaus for his life.

entities.name: Adrestus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Hyrtacus
entities.body: Father of Asius.

entities.name: Adamas
entities.body: Son of Asius, one of the Trojan captains at the wall.

entities.name: Iamenus
entities.body: A Trojan captain in Asius’s company.

entities.name: Oenomaus
entities.body: A Trojan captain in Asius’s company.

entities.name: Oenomaus
entities.body: A Greek killed by Ares and Hector.

entities.name: Thoon
entities.body: A Trojan captain in Asius’s company.

entities.name: Thoon
entities.body: A son of Phaenops killed by Diomed.

entities.name: Thoon
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Thoon
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Antilochus from behind.

entities.name: Alcathous
entities.body: A Trojan captain, Anchises’ son-in-law, killed by Idomeneus.

entities.name: Othryoneus
entities.body: A newcomer from Cabesus who asked for Cassandra and offered to drive the Greeks away.

entities.name: Caletor
entities.body: Son of the elder Clytius, killed by Ajax as he carried fire to the ships.

entities.name: Lycophontes
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Amopaon
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer, son of Polyaemon.

entities.name: Polyaemon
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Amopaon.

entities.name: Daetor
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Archeptolemus
entities.body: Son of Iphitus, Hector’s charioteer after Eniopeus.

entities.name: Eniopeus
entities.body: Son of Thebaeus and Hector’s charioteer, killed by Diomed.

entities.name: Thebaeus
entities.body: Father of Hector’s charioteer Eniopeus.

entities.name: Dolopion
entities.body: Priest of the river Scamander and father of Hypsenor.

entities.name: Hypsenor
entities.body: Son of Dolopion the river-priest, killed by Eurypylus.

entities.name: Hypsenor
entities.body: Son of Hippasus, a Greek killed by Deiphobus.

entities.name: Hippasus
entities.body: Father of the Greek Hypsenor.

entities.name: Hippasus
entities.body: Father of Socus and Charops.

entities.name: Hippasus
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Apisaon killed by Lycomedes.

entities.name: Socus
entities.body: A rich Trojan, son of Hippasus, who wounds Odysseus and is killed by him.

entities.name: Charops
entities.body: Socus’s brother, son of Hippasus, killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Apisaon
entities.body: Son of Phausius, a Trojan killed by Eurypylus.

entities.name: Apisaon
entities.body: Son of Hippasus, a Trojan captain killed by Lycomedes.

entities.name: Phausius
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Apisaon killed by Eurypylus.

entities.name: Leiocritus
entities.body: Son of Arisbas and a follower of Lycomedes, killed by Aeneas.

entities.name: Arisbas
entities.body: Father of the Greek Leiocritus.

entities.name: Euchenor
entities.body: Son of the seer Polyidus, who came to Troy knowing it would kill him.

entities.name: Polyidus
entities.body: A seer of Corinth, father of Euchenor, who foretold his son’s death.

entities.name: Polyidus
entities.body: A son of the dream-reader Eurydamas, killed by Diomed.

entities.name: Abas
entities.body: A son of the dream-reader Eurydamas, killed by Diomed.

entities.name: Eurydamas
entities.body: An old reader of dreams whose two sons Diomed killed.

entities.name: Podes
entities.body: Son of Eetion, a rich Trojan and Hector’s friend at table, killed by Menelaus.

entities.name: Eetion
entities.body: King of Cilician Thebe and Andromache’s father, killed by Achilles.

entities.name: Eetion
entities.body: A guest-friend of Imbros who ransomed Lycaon out of Lemnos.

entities.name: Eetion
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Podes.

entities.name: Mentor
entities.body: A Trojan rich in horses, father of Imbrius.

entities.name: Imbrius
entities.body: Son of Mentor, married to a bastard daughter of Priam, killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Medesicaste
entities.body: A bastard daughter of Priam, married to Imbrius.

entities.name: Echepolus
entities.body: Son of Thalysius, the first Trojan killed in the fighting.

entities.name: Echepolus
entities.body: A rich man of Sicyon, son of Anchises, who gave Agamemnon the mare Aethe to avoid the war.

entities.name: Thalysius
entities.body: Father of the first Trojan killed.

entities.name: Anchises
entities.body: A man of Sicyon, father of Echepolus.

entities.name: Simoeisius
entities.body: Son of Anthemion, born by the banks of the Simois, killed by Ajax.

entities.name: Anthemion
entities.body: Father of Simoeisius.

entities.name: Leucus
entities.body: A comrade of Odysseus killed by Antiphus’s stray spear.

entities.name: Democoon
entities.body: A bastard son of Priam from Abydos, killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Elatus
entities.body: A Trojan of Pedasus on the Satnioeis, killed by Agamemnon.

entities.name: Melanthus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Eurypylus.

entities.name: Phegeus
entities.body: A son of the priest Dares, killed by Diomed.

entities.name: Idaeus
entities.body: A son of the priest Dares, saved by Hephaestus.

entities.name: Dares
entities.body: A rich and blameless Trojan, priest of Hephaestus, father of Phegeus and Idaeus.

entities.name: Phaesus
entities.body: Son of Borus the Meonian, killed by Idomeneus.

entities.name: Scamandrius
entities.body: Son of Strophius, a mighty huntsman taught by Artemis, killed by Menelaus.

entities.name: Strophius
entities.body: Father of the huntsman Scamandrius.

entities.name: Phereclus
entities.body: Son of Tecton, the shipwright who built the ships that carried Paris to Sparta.

entities.name: Tecton
entities.body: Father of the shipwright Phereclus.

entities.name: Hermon
entities.body: Grandfather of the shipwright Phereclus.

entities.name: Astynous
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Diomed at the opening of his rampage.

entities.name: Astynous
entities.body: Son of Protiaon, who is given Hector’s horses to hold.

entities.name: Protiaon
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Astynous.

entities.name: Hypeiron
entities.body: A Trojan shepherd of his people killed by Diomed.

entities.name: Xanthus
entities.body: A son of Phaenops killed by Diomed, one of two who left their father childless.

entities.name: Phaenops
entities.body: An old Trojan whose two sons Diomed killed, leaving him without an heir.

entities.name: Phaenops
entities.body: Father of the Phrygian leader Phorcys.

entities.name: Phaenops
entities.body: A man of Abydos, Hector’s dearest guest-friend, whose likeness Apollo takes.

entities.name: Chersidamas
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Deiopites
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Crethon
entities.body: One of the twin sons of Diocles of Phere, killed by Aeneas.

entities.name: Orsilochus
entities.body: One of the twin sons of Diocles of Phere, killed by Aeneas.

entities.name: Orsilochus
entities.body: Son of the river Alpheus and father of Diocles, a ruler over much people.

entities.name: Orsilochus
entities.body: A Trojan, the first man Teucer killed.

entities.name: Diocles
entities.body: A rich man of Phere, son of Orsilochus and father of the twins Crethon and Orsilochus.

entities.name: Deicoon
entities.body: Son of Pergasus, a comrade of Aeneas honoured like one of Priam’s sons, killed by Agamemnon.

entities.name: Pergasus
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Deicoon.

entities.name: Aesepus
entities.body: A son of Bucolion by the nymph Abarbarea, killed by Euryalus.

entities.name: Pedasus
entities.body: A son of Bucolion by the nymph Abarbarea, killed by Euryalus.

entities.name: Bucolion
entities.body: Laomedon’s eldest son, born out of wedlock, father of twins by a naiad.

entities.name: Abarbarea
entities.body: The naiad nymph who bore twins to Bucolion.

entities.name: Dresus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Euryalus.

entities.name: Opheltius
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Euryalus.

entities.name: Opheltius
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector.

entities.name: Astyalus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Polypoetes.

entities.name: Pidytes
entities.body: A man of Percote killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Aretaon
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Ablerus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Antilochus.

entities.name: Axylus
entities.body: A rich and hospitable man of Arisbe, son of Teuthranus, killed by Diomed.

entities.name: Teuthranus
entities.body: Father of Axylus of Arisbe.

entities.name: Calesius
entities.body: Axylus’s squire and charioteer, killed with him.

entities.name: Menesthes
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector, sharing a chariot with Anchialus.

entities.name: Anchialus
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector, sharing a chariot with Menesthes.

entities.name: Amphius
entities.body: A rich man of Paesus, son of Selagus, killed by Ajax.

entities.name: Selagus
entities.body: Father of Amphius of Paesus.

entities.name: Teuthras
entities.body: A Greek killed by Ares and Hector.

entities.name: Trechus
entities.body: An Aetolian killed by Ares and Hector.

entities.name: Helenus
entities.body: Son of Oenops, a Greek killed by Ares and Hector.

entities.name: Oenops
entities.body: Father of the Greek Helenus.

entities.name: Oresbius
entities.body: A wealthy man of the Cephisian lake, killed by Ares and Hector.

entities.name: Periphas
entities.body: Son of Ochesius and the bravest of the Aetolians, killed by Ares.

entities.name: Periphas
entities.body: Son of Epytus, an old herald of Anchises, whose likeness Apollo takes.

entities.name: Ochesius
entities.body: Father of the Aetolian Periphas.

entities.name: Epytus
entities.body: Father of Anchises’ herald Periphas.

entities.name: Coeranus
entities.body: A Lycian killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Coiranus
entities.body: Meriones’s charioteer from Lyctus, killed saving Idomeneus.

entities.name: Alastor
entities.body: A Lycian killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Alastor
entities.body: A Pylian chief marshalling Nestor’s men.

entities.name: Alastor
entities.body: A Greek squire who helps carry the wounded from the field.

entities.name: Alastor
entities.body: Father of the young Trojan Tros killed by Achilles.

entities.name: Chromius
entities.body: A Lycian killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Chromius
entities.body: A Pylian chief marshalling Nestor’s men.

entities.name: Chromius
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Chromius
entities.body: A Trojan captain who goes with Aeneas and Aretus against Automedon.

entities.name: Alcandrus
entities.body: A Lycian killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Halius
entities.body: A Lycian killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Noemon
entities.body: A Lycian killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Noemon
entities.body: A comrade of Antilochus, given the mare he wins at the games.

entities.name: Prytanis
entities.body: A Lycian killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Mydon
entities.body: Son of Atymnius, Pylaemenes’s charioteer, killed by Antilochus.

entities.name: Mydon
entities.body: A Paeonian killed by Achilles in the river.

entities.name: Atymnius
entities.body: Father of the charioteer Mydon.

entities.name: Otus
entities.body: A giant son of Aloeus who bound Ares in a bronze jar.

entities.name: Otus
entities.body: A Cyllenian captain of the Epeans, killed by Polydamas.

entities.name: Ephialtes
entities.body: A giant son of Aloeus who bound Ares in a bronze jar with his brother.

entities.name: Aloeus
entities.body: Father of the giants Otus and Ephialtes.

entities.name: Eeriboea
entities.body: Stepmother to the sons of Aloeus, who told Hermes where Ares was imprisoned.

entities.name: Amphitryon
entities.body: Alcmena’s husband; Heracles is called his son.

entities.name: Aegialeia
entities.body: Diomed’s wife, daughter of Adrastus.

entities.name: Deipylus
entities.body: Sthenelus’s chosen comrade, to whom he gives the captured horses.

entities.name: Hypeirochus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Hippodamus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Thymbraeus
entities.body: A Trojan struck from his chariot by Diomed.

entities.name: Molion
entities.body: Thymbraeus’s squire, killed by Odysseus.

entities.name: Bienor
entities.body: A Trojan leader, the first man Agamemnon killed in his rampage.

entities.name: Oileus
entities.body: Bienor’s charioteer, killed by Agamemnon.

entities.name: Antimachus
entities.body: The Trojan who took Paris’s gold and argued against giving Helen back.

entities.name: Pisander
entities.body: A son of Antimachus, killed by Agamemnon.

entities.name: Hippolochus
entities.body: A son of Antimachus, killed by Agamemnon.

entities.name: Pisander
entities.body: A Trojan who fights Menelaus hand to hand with a battle-axe.

entities.name: Agastrophus
entities.body: Son of Paeon, killed by Diomed after leaving his chariot too far off.

entities.name: Paeon
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Agastrophus.

entities.name: Asaeus
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector.

entities.name: Autonous
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector.

entities.name: Autonous
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Opites
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector.

entities.name: Dolops
entities.body: Son of Clytius, a Greek killed by Hector.

entities.name: Dolops
entities.body: Son of the Trojan elder Lampus, killed by Meges and Menelaus.

entities.name: Clytius
entities.body: Father of the Greek Dolops killed by Hector.

entities.name: Agelaus
entities.body: Son of Phradmon, a Trojan killed by Diomed.

entities.name: Agelaus
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector.

entities.name: Phradmon
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Agelaus.

entities.name: Aesymnus
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector.

entities.name: Orus
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector.

entities.name: Hipponous
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector.

entities.name: Pandocus
entities.body: A Trojan wounded by Ajax.

entities.name: Lysandrus
entities.body: A Trojan wounded by Ajax.

entities.name: Pyrasus
entities.body: A Trojan wounded by Ajax.

entities.name: Pylartes
entities.body: A Trojan wounded by Ajax.

entities.name: Pylartes
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Itymoneus
entities.body: A man of Elis killed by the young Nestor in a cattle raid.

entities.name: Mulius
entities.body: Augeas’s son-in-law, the first man the young Nestor killed.

entities.name: Mulius
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Mulius
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Achilles with a spear through the ear.

entities.name: Agamede
entities.body: Augeas’s eldest daughter, who knew every herb that grows.

entities.name: Thootes
entities.body: Menestheus’s herald, sent to fetch Ajax to the wall.

entities.name: Epicles
entities.body: A comrade of Sarpedon killed by Ajax with a stone.

entities.name: Alcmaon
entities.body: Son of Thestor, a Greek killed by Sarpedon.

entities.name: Antiphates
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Leonteus at the wall.

entities.name: Menon
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Leonteus at the wall.

entities.name: Pylon
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Leonteus at the wall.

entities.name: Ormenus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Leonteus at the wall.

entities.name: Ormenus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Ormenus
entities.body: Amyntor’s father, Phoenix’s grandfather.

entities.name: Hippomachus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Leonteus at the wall.

entities.name: Amyntor
entities.body: Phoenix’s father, who cursed him over a concubine; Autolycus once robbed his house.

entities.name: Laodamas
entities.body: Antenor’s son, a captain of foot soldiers, killed by Ajax.

entities.name: Deiochus
entities.body: A Greek struck down by Paris as he fled.

entities.name: Sphelus
entities.body: Father of Iasus of Athens.

entities.name: Iasus
entities.body: A leader of the Athenians, son of Sphelus, killed by Aeneas.

entities.name: Boucolos
entities.body: Grandfather of the Athenian Iasus.

entities.name: Mecisteus
entities.body: Son of Echius, a Greek squire who helps carry the wounded off the field.

entities.name: Mecisteus
entities.body: Son of Talaus, Euryalus’s father, who once won every prize at Thebes.

entities.name: Mecisteus
entities.body: A Greek killed by Polydamas.

entities.name: Echius
entities.body: Father of the Greek squire Mecisteus.

entities.name: Echius
entities.body: A Greek killed by Polites.

entities.name: Echius
entities.body: Son of Damastor, a Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Damastor
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Echius.

entities.name: Talaus
entities.body: Euryalus’s grandfather.

entities.name: Euryalus
entities.body: Son of Mecisteus and one of Diomed’s companions; he boxes Epeus at the funeral games.

entities.name: Cleitus
entities.body: Son of Pisenor and Polydamas’s comrade, shot by Teucer as he drove for Hector.

entities.name: Pisenor
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Cleitus.

entities.name: Melanippus
entities.body: Son of Hiketaon, a Trojan whom Hector rebukes and Antilochus kills.

entities.name: Melanippus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Melanippus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Melanippus
entities.body: A Greek captain who goes with Achilles to Agamemnon’s tent.

entities.name: Periphetes
entities.body: A man of Mycenae, son of Copreus, the best of his father’s line; killed by Hector after tripping on his shield.

entities.name: Periphetes
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Copreus
entities.body: Eurystheus’s herald to Heracles, father of Periphetes of Mycenae.

entities.name: Lycophron
entities.body: Mastor’s son of Cythera, Ajax’s squire, killed by Hector.

entities.name: Mastor
entities.body: Father of Ajax’s squire Lycophron.

entities.name: Euphetes
entities.body: King of Ephyra, who gave Phyleus the corslet Meges wears.

entities.name: Hyrtius
entities.body: Son of Gyrtius and captain of the Mysians, killed by Ajax.

entities.name: Gyrtius
entities.body: Father of the Mysian captain Hyrtius.

entities.name: Phalces
entities.body: A Trojan captain, killed by Antilochus.

entities.name: Mermerus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Antilochus.

entities.name: Morys
entities.body: Son of Hippotion, a Trojan killed by Meriones.

entities.name: Hippotion
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Morys, killed by Meriones.

entities.name: Prothoon
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Hyperenor
entities.body: A son of Panthous, wounded by Menelaus and boasted over.

entities.name: Orthaeus
entities.body: A Trojan captain in the press about Cebriones.

entities.name: Polyphetes
entities.body: A Trojan captain in the press about Cebriones.

entities.name: Palmys
entities.body: A Trojan captain in the press about Cebriones.

entities.name: Erymas
entities.body: A Trojan speared in the mouth by Idomeneus.

entities.name: Erymas
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Lycon
entities.body: A Trojan who fights Peneleos hand to hand and is killed by him.

entities.name: Cleobulus
entities.body: A Trojan taken alive and killed by Ajax the less.

entities.name: Amisodorus
entities.body: The man who reared the Chimaera; his two sons fell to the sons of Nestor.

entities.name: The Chimaera
entities.body: The monster Bellerophon killed, reared by Amisodorus. The modern edition spells it Chimera.

entities.name: Laogonus
entities.body: Son of Onetor the priest of Zeus, killed by Meriones.

entities.name: Laogonus
entities.body: A Trojan, son of Bias, killed by Achilles.

entities.name: Onetor
entities.body: Priest of Zeus of Ida and father of the Trojan Laogonus.

entities.name: Bathycles
entities.body: A rich Myrmidon of Hellas, son of Chalcon, killed by Glaucus.

entities.name: Chalcon
entities.body: Father of the Myrmidon Bathycles.

entities.name: Sthenelaus
entities.body: Son of Ithaemenes, a Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Ithaemenes
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Sthenelaus.

entities.name: Pronous
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Thestor
entities.body: Enops’s son, a Trojan charioteer hooked out of his chariot by Patroclus.

entities.name: Thestor
entities.body: Calchas’s father.

entities.name: Thestor
entities.body: Father of the Greek Alcmaon killed by Sarpedon.

entities.name: Enops
entities.body: Father of the charioteer Thestor and of Satnius by a naiad.

entities.name: Satnius
entities.body: Son of Enops by a naiad nymph, wounded by Ajax the less.

entities.name: Amphoterus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Epaltes
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Pyris
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Ipheus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Euippus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Polymelus
entities.body: Son of Argeas, a Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Argeas
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Polymelus.

entities.name: Echeclus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Echeclus
entities.body: Son of Agenor, a Trojan cut down by Achilles.

entities.name: Perimus
entities.body: Son of Megas, a Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Megas
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Perimus.

entities.name: Epistor
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Elasus
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Patroclus.

entities.name: Thersilochus
entities.body: A Paeonian captain, killed by Achilles in the river.

entities.name: Deisenor
entities.body: A Trojan ally whom Hector cheers on over Patroclus’s body.

entities.name: Aretus
entities.body: A Trojan who goes with Chromius and Aeneas against Automedon and is killed.

entities.name: Epeus
entities.body: Son of Panopeus, a skilful boxer who beats Euryalus at the funeral games.

entities.name: Panopeus
entities.body: Father of the boxer Epeus.

entities.name: Astypylus
entities.body: A Paeonian killed by Achilles in the river.

entities.name: Mnesus
entities.body: A Paeonian killed by Achilles in the river.

entities.name: Thrasius
entities.body: A Paeonian killed by Achilles in the river.

entities.name: Oeneus
entities.body: A Paeonian killed by Achilles in the river.

entities.name: Ophelestes
entities.body: A Paeonian killed by Achilles in the river.

entities.name: Ophelestes
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Teucer.

entities.name: Iphition
entities.body: Son of Otrynteus by a naiad, a leader of much people, the first man Achilles killed on his return.

entities.name: Otrynteus
entities.body: Father of Iphition, a city-sacker of Meonia.

entities.name: Demoleon
entities.body: A son of Antenor, killed by Achilles.

entities.name: Hippodamas
entities.body: A Trojan killed by Achilles as he sprang from his chariot.

entities.name: Demouchus
entities.body: Son of Philetor, a big and powerful Trojan killed by Achilles.

entities.name: Philetor
entities.body: Father of the Trojan Demouchus.

entities.name: Deucalion
entities.body: A Trojan whose arm Achilles pinned before beheading him.

entities.name: Deucalion
entities.body: Minos’s son and Idomeneus’s father.

entities.name: Rhigmus
entities.body: Son of Peires, a Thracian killed by Achilles.

entities.name: Peires
entities.body: Father of the Thracian Rhigmus.

entities.name: Areithous
entities.body: Rhigmus’s squire, killed by Achilles.

entities.name: Areithous
entities.body: The Mace-man of Arne, father of Menesthius.

entities.name: Phylomedusa
entities.body: Wife of Areithous the Mace-man and mother of Menesthius.

entities.name: Eioneus
entities.body: A Greek killed by Hector at the single-combat challenge.

entities.name: Iphinous
entities.body: Son of Dexius, a Greek killed by Glaucus.

entities.name: Dexius
entities.body: Father of the Greek Iphinous.

entities.name: Promachus
entities.body: A Boeotian killed by Acamas, son of Alegenor.

entities.name: Alegenor
entities.body: Father of the Boeotian Promachus.

entities.name: Ilioneus
entities.body: The only son of the rich flock-master Phorbas, killed by Peneleos.

entities.name: Heracles
entities.body: Zeus’s mortal son, who sacked Troy in Laomedon’s day. Butler’s original calls him Hercules.

entities.name: Alcmena
entities.body: Heracles’ mother, whom Zeus loved in Thebes. The modern edition spells her Alcmene.

entities.name: Eurystheus
entities.body: The king who set Heracles his labours, born before him by Hera’s contrivance.

entities.name: Bellerophon
entities.body: The hero of Glaucus’s family story, sent to Lycia with a sealed message and set three deadly tasks.

entities.name: Proetus
entities.body: The king who drove Bellerophon out of Argos with a letter meant to kill him.

entities.name: Sisyphus
entities.body: The craftiest of mankind, Glaucus’s ancestor, who lived at Ephyra.

entities.name: Aeolus
entities.body: Sisyphus’s father.

entities.name: Isander
entities.body: A son of Bellerophon, killed by Ares fighting the Solymi.

entities.name: Laodameia
entities.body: Bellerophon’s daughter, who bore Sarpedon to Zeus.

entities.name: Lycurgus
entities.body: Son of Dryas, who drove Dionysus into the sea and was blinded for it.

entities.name: Dryas
entities.body: Lycurgus’s father; also one of the great men of Nestor’s youth.

entities.name: Caeneus
entities.body: One of the great men of Nestor’s youth.

entities.name: Exadius
entities.body: One of the great men of Nestor’s youth.

entities.name: Polyphemus
entities.body: One of the great men of Nestor’s youth, named among the Lapiths.

entities.name: Theseus
entities.body: Son of Aegeus, named among the great men of Nestor’s youth.

entities.name: Aegeus
entities.body: Theseus’s father.

entities.name: Ereuthalion
entities.body: The champion the young Nestor killed in single combat.

entities.name: Pelops
entities.body: The mighty charioteer, from whom Agamemnon’s sceptre descends.

entities.name: Thyestes
entities.body: Atreus’s brother, rich in flocks, who held the sceptre before Agamemnon.

entities.name: Adrastus
entities.body: The old king who reigned at Sicyon; his line married into Tydeus’s.

entities.name: Polynices
entities.body: The exile with whom Tydeus went to Mycenae to raise an army against Thebes.

entities.name: Eteocles
entities.body: The Theban in whose house Tydeus found the Cadmeans feasting.

entities.name: Maeon
entities.body: Son of Haemon, one of the two Theban captains who ambushed Tydeus and the only one he spared.

entities.name: Polyphontes
entities.body: Son of Autophonus and one of the two Theban captains who ambushed Tydeus.

entities.name: Autophonus
entities.body: Father of the Theban captain Polyphontes.

entities.name: Oedipus
entities.body: The Theban king at whose funeral games Mecisteus beat everyone.

entities.name: Cadmus
entities.body: The founder of Thebes; its people are called after him.

entities.name: Meleager
entities.body: The Aetolian hero of Phoenix’s story, who withdrew from the fighting in anger and came back too late for the gifts.

entities.name: Oeneus
entities.body: King of Calydon, Meleager’s father, whose neglected sacrifice brought the boar.

entities.name: Althaea
entities.body: Meleager’s mother, who cursed him for killing her brother.

entities.name: Cleopatra
entities.body: Meleager’s wife, who persuaded him to fight at last.

entities.name: Marpessa
entities.body: Cleopatra’s mother, over whom Ides faced Apollo himself.

entities.name: Ides
entities.body: The man who took his bow against Apollo for Marpessa’s sake.

entities.name: Euenus
entities.body: Marpessa’s father.

entities.name: Alcyone
entities.body: The by-name Cleopatra’s parents gave her, after the halcyon’s cry.

entities.name: Niobe
entities.body: The mother of twelve children killed by Apollo and Artemis, who ate at last for all her grief.

entities.name: Danae
entities.body: Acrisius’s daughter, mother of Perseus by Zeus. The original spells her Danae, the modern Danaë.

entities.name: Acrisius
entities.body: Danae’s father.

entities.name: Perseus
entities.body: Danae’s son by Zeus, the famed hero and Sthenelus’s father.

entities.name: Sthenelus
entities.body: Son of Perseus and father of Eurystheus.

entities.name: Capaneus
entities.body: Father of Diomed’s companion Sthenelus.

entities.name: Semele
entities.body: A woman of Thebes by whom Zeus begot Dionysus.

entities.name: Minos
entities.body: Zeus’s son by the daughter of Phoenix, chief ruler in Crete and Deucalion’s father.

entities.name: Rhadamanthus
entities.body: Zeus’s son by the daughter of Phoenix, Minos’s brother.

entities.name: Phoenix
entities.body: The father of the woman who bore Minos and Rhadamanthus to Zeus.

entities.name: Ixion
entities.body: The man whose wife bore Pirithous to Zeus.

entities.name: Typhoeus
entities.body: The monster lashed by Zeus’s thunder in the land of the Arimi.

entities.name: Jason
entities.body: Father of Eueneus of Lemnos by Hypsipyle.

entities.name: Eueneus
entities.body: Son of Jason, who sent wine from Lemnos and bought Lycaon as a slave. The modern edition spells him Euneus.

entities.name: Hypsipyle
entities.body: Eueneus’s mother.

entities.name: Eurytus
entities.body: King of Oechalia, who boasted he could outshoot Apollo.

entities.name: Thamyris
entities.body: The minstrel the Muses met at Dorium and silenced for his boasting.

entities.name: Aesculapius
entities.body: The healer, father of Machaon and Podalirius. The modern edition calls him Asclepius.

entities.name: Chiron
entities.body: The centaur who gave Aesculapius his drugs and Peleus the great ash spear.

entities.name: Minyas
entities.body: The old ruler of Orchomenus, whose realm it is called.

entities.name: Erechtheus
entities.body: The earth-born king of Athens whom Athena established in her own sanctuary.

entities.name: Pittheus
entities.body: Father of Helen’s handmaid Aethrae.

entities.name: Aethrae
entities.body: One of Helen’s two handmaids in Troy.

entities.name: Clymene
entities.body: One of Helen’s two handmaids in Troy.

entities.name: Castor
entities.body: Helen’s brother, a breaker of horses, whom she cannot find among the Greeks.

entities.name: Pollux
entities.body: Helen’s brother, a mighty boxer, whom she cannot find among the Greeks.

entities.name: Otreus
entities.body: A Phrygian leader with whom Priam once camped as an ally.

entities.name: Mygdon
entities.body: A Phrygian leader with whom Priam once camped as an ally.

entities.name: The Amazons
entities.body: The women who fight like men, who once came against the Phrygians.

entities.name: Daedalus
entities.body: The craftsman who made the dancing-floor at Cnossus for Ariadne.

entities.name: Ariadne
entities.body: Minos’s daughter, for whom Daedalus made the dancing-floor.

entities.name: Makar
entities.body: The old ruler of Lesbos, named in measuring the bounds of Priam’s former wealth.

entities.name: Eumedes
entities.body: The famous herald, Dolon’s father.

entities.name: Autolycus
entities.body: The thief who stole the boar’s-tusk helmet out of Amyntor’s house.

entities.name: Amphidamas
entities.body: The man of Cythera to whom Autolycus gave the boar’s-tusk helmet.

entities.name: Molus
entities.body: Meriones’s father, who was given the boar’s-tusk helmet.

entities.name: Hippocoon
entities.body: Rhesus’s kinsman and comrade, roused by Apollo to find the Thracian camp plundered.

entities.name: Argus
entities.body: The watcher Hermes killed; the god is called his slayer throughout.

entities.name: The Sintians
entities.body: The people of Lemnos who tended Hephaestus when he fell out of heaven.

entities.name: The Curetes
entities.body: The people who fought the Aetolians round Calydon in Phoenix’s story.

entities.name: The Lapithae
entities.body: The people of Polypoetes and Leonteus, who drove the mountain savages from Pelion.

entities.name: The mountain savages
entities.body: The shaggy hill-dwellers Pirithous drove from Pelion to the Aithices.

entities.name: Hippodameia
entities.body: Pirithous’s wife, who bore Polypoetes on the day he took his revenge on the mountain savages.

entities.name: The Hippemolgi
entities.body: The noble milk-drinking people of the north, on whom Zeus turns his eyes away from Troy.

entities.name: The Selli
entities.body: The prophets of Zeus at Dodona, who sleep on the ground with unwashed feet.

entities.name: The Achaeans
entities.body: The Greek army before Troy; the poem calls them Achaeans, Argives and Danaans indifferently.

entities.name: The Trojans
entities.body: The people of Troy and Hector’s army.

entities.name: The Myrmidons
entities.body: Achilles’ own people, who sit out the fighting with him.

entities.name: The Lycians
entities.body: Sarpedon and Glaucus’s people, the strongest of Troy’s allies.

entities.name: The Dardanians
entities.body: Aeneas’s people, of the older Trojan line.

entities.name: The Boeotians
entities.body: The Greek contingent under Peneleos, Leitus and their fellow captains.

entities.name: The Locrians
entities.body: Ajax the less’s people, light-armed men who fight with bow and sling.

entities.name: The Abantes
entities.body: The fierce spearmen of Euboea under Elephenor.

entities.name: The Athenians
entities.body: The Greek contingent under Menestheus.

entities.name: The Phoceans
entities.body: The Greek contingent under Schedius and Epistrophus.

entities.name: The Cretans
entities.body: Idomeneus and Meriones’s people, from the hundred cities of Crete.

entities.name: The Epeans
entities.body: The people of Elis and Buprasium, under four captains.

entities.name: The Cephallenians
entities.body: Odysseus’s people, of Ithaca and the islands.

entities.name: The Aetolians
entities.body: Thoas’s people, of Pleuron and Calydon.

entities.name: The Arcadians
entities.body: Agapenor’s people, who sailed in ships Agamemnon lent them.

entities.name: The Pylians
entities.body: Nestor’s people.

entities.name: The Phthians
entities.body: The men of Phthia, led by Medon and Podarces.

entities.name: The Lesbians
entities.body: The women of Lesbos whom Achilles took, offered back among Agamemnon’s gifts.

entities.name: The Thracians
entities.body: Troy’s allies from beyond the Hellespont, under Acamas and Peirous.

entities.name: The Paeonians
entities.body: Troy’s allies from Amydon on the Axius, archers and then spearmen.

entities.name: The Mysians
entities.body: Troy’s allies under Chromis and Ennomus the augur.

entities.name: The Phrygians
entities.body: Troy’s allies from Ascania under Phorcys and Ascanius.

entities.name: The Meonians
entities.body: Troy’s allies from under Mount Tmolus.

entities.name: The Carians
entities.body: Troy’s allies of a strange speech, under Nastes and Amphimachus.

entities.name: The Paphlagonians
entities.body: Troy’s allies under Pylaemenes.

entities.name: The Halizoni
entities.body: Troy’s allies from Alybe, where the silver comes from.

entities.name: The Cicons
entities.body: Troy’s allies; the modern edition spells them Cicones.

entities.name: The Pelasgi
entities.body: Troy’s Pelasgian allies from Larissa; the modern edition calls them Pelasgians.

entities.name: The Lelegae
entities.body: Altes’s people, whom Achilles attacked with the Trojans. The modern edition calls them Leleges.

entities.name: The Cauconians
entities.body: A people camped on the Trojan side, named by Dolon.

entities.name: The Cadmeans
entities.body: The people of Thebes, who ambushed Tydeus.

entities.name: The Hellenes
entities.body: The people of Hellas, named beside the Achaeans.

entities.name: The Cilicians
entities.body: Eetion’s people at Thebe under Mount Placus.

entities.name: The Ethiopians
entities.body: The people at whose feast Zeus and the gods are entertained.

entities.name: The Solymi
entities.body: The far-famed people Bellerophon fought, the hardest of his battles.

entities.name: The Dolopians
entities.body: The people on the borders of Phthia over whom Peleus made Phoenix ruler.

entities.name: The Peraebi
entities.body: The people who followed Guneus from about Dodona.

entities.name: The Enienes
entities.body: The people who followed Guneus from about Dodona.

entities.name: The Magnetes
entities.body: Prothous’s people, by the Peneus and Mount Pelion.

entities.name: Xanthus
entities.body: One of Achilles’ two immortal horses, born to the west wind; Hera gives him speech to warn his master.

entities.name: Balius
entities.body: Achilles’ other immortal horse, born to the west wind.

entities.name: Pedasus
entities.body: The mortal trace-horse Achilles took at Thebe, killed beside the immortal pair.

entities.name: Xanthus
entities.body: One of Hector’s four horses, called on by name before the ships.

entities.name: Podargus
entities.body: One of Hector’s four horses; also the name of Menelaus’s own horse at the games.

entities.name: Aethon
entities.body: One of Hector’s four horses.

entities.name: Lampus
entities.body: One of Hector’s four horses.

entities.name: Aethe
entities.body: Agamemnon’s mare, lent to Menelaus for the chariot race.

entities.name: Arion
entities.body: Adrastus’s horse, of divine race, named as the fastest there is.
